metadata.title: OMEGA Foreign-Exchange Reserve Reference Registry
metadata.valueMeaning: Reference foreign-exchange reserve assets in USD from the existing repository baseline. These are not the player's current mutable in-game reserve balance.
metadata.dataPolicy: The two existing data sets were reconciled record-by-record. A value is retained only where all recorded source fields agree. Null means not recorded; it never means zero. No reserve figure is fabricated.
metadata.provenanceWarning: The existing local baseline is dated 2015 and has not been independently revalidated against current official World Bank, IMF, or national-central-bank reserve series.
metadata.runtimeOwnership: Immutable reference/seeding data only. Mutable simulation reserve balances are stored separately under governmentBanking.forex.reserveAccountsByCountry.
